chapter_seo_title: The Ananda's Universal Salvation Sword - Ji Ning Returns Home to a New Beginning
chapter_meta_description: After a brutal battle, Ji Ning returns to the Black-White College for a touching family reunion. He formulates a plan to find his parents' reincarnations and learns his divine child will be born after an extraordinary five-year gestation.
og_title: Ji Ning's Family Reunion and the Birth of Hope
og_description: A chapter of warmth and emotion as Ji Ning reunites with his family and learns of his unborn child's extraordinary destiny.
twitter_title: Ji Ning gets the call: You're going to be a dad!
twitter_description: A soft, emotional breather chapter shows Ji Ning's personal stakes—family—before the next storm. His child will be born in five years!

lore_anchors.definition: A mythological figure in Chinese folklore, born after a three-year gestation; a symbol of extraordinary birth and rebellion against heaven.
A traditional Chinese harvest festival celebrated on the 15th day of the 8th lunar month, symbolizing family reunion and harmony.
